name: LegalHoldNoticeManager
tagline: Issue legal holds, track custodian acknowledgements, remind, escalate and release – in one Power Apps component.
description: Complete legal hold app for law firms, legal departments and investigations teams: hold register with preservation scope and data sources, custodian notices with acknowledgement deadlines, automatic reminders and escalation to line managers, periodic re-affirmation, two-step release with counsel approval, custodian self-service and a dated activity log. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to Dataverse, SharePoint, SQL, Excel or a collection.
features: Issue rules: counsel role, scope, data sources, custodians
Reminder interval and auto-escalation after n reminders
Release request with reason and counsel approval
Bulk reminders, notices, acknowledgements and releases
Board with drag & drop and keyboard moves
Undo, validation, read-only, empty and map-your-columns states
Power Fx outputs and six events
controlType: standard (2 controls: LegalHoldNoticeManager data-set, LegalHoldNoticeManagerPortal field)
